# Seeds for the markdown signing-base fuzz tests (verify, patrol, judge, signing). One seed per block;
# blocks are separated by a line holding exactly "=====". Lines beginning "# " before the first block are
# this header. Each seed is a document body a writer might publish: the shapes that broke verification once.

# Hello

Body text.
